items.title: UN warns of 'supersized' El Niño as countries prepare for impact
items.description: The WMO has warned that the natural weather phenomenon could bring disruption to global economies.

items.title: Toxic wildfire haze spreads across South East Asia as 'super' El Niño intensifies
items.description: Millions of people have been exposed to the smog, with more than 12,000 children suffering respiratory issues.

items.title: Feminist activist and journalist Gloria Steinem dies, aged 92
items.description: Her foundation said she "passed away peacefully" at her home in New York City, "surrounded by many who loved her".

items.title: 'Beautiful, vibrant' Disney star Carla Jeffery dies aged 33
items.description: Jeffery was known for playing cheerleader Bree in 2018 Disney Channel movie Zombies and two sequels.

items.title: ICE agent charged with lying about shooting Venezuelan man during crackdown
items.description: The ICE officer faces federal charges related to the January shooting in Minnesota.

items.title: More than 80 migrants feared dead after boat rescued off Canary Islands
items.description: Rescuers found 44 survivors on board the vessel but bad weather meant they had to leave five bodies behind.

items.title: Anthony Joshua's driver attempted overtake before fatal crash, trial hears
items.description: Adeniyi Mobolaji Kayode is charged in Nigeria with offences including causing death by dangerous driving.

items.title: Embattled Spanish PM insists there were no prior warnings before Ceuta crisis

items.title: Trump $1 coin makes him first living president on US currency in a century

items.title: Kenyan president orders crackdown on foreigners operating small businesses
